p: 《雪人兄弟》是 Toaplan 于 1990 年推出的街机平台跳跃动作游戏，后移植到 FC / NES。本站收录的是日版 ROM，打开页面即可直接游玩。
故事里 Nick 与 Tom 两兄弟被魔王变成了雪人，为了营救被抓走的公主，他们一路喷雪战斗，关卡越往后敌人越多、速度越快。
p_en: Snow Bros. is a platform action game released by Toaplan in arcades in 1990 and later ported to the NES. This site hosts the Japanese ROM, playable instantly in your browser.
Brothers Nick and Tom have been turned into snowmen by a demon king. To rescue the kidnapped princesses, they fight onward with snow spray as enemies grow faster and fiercer.

p: 每一关都会出现若干怪物，朝敌人连续喷雪，把它整个裹成大雪球，再推动雪球撞倒沿途的敌人。将全场敌人消灭干净即可过关，每隔若干关会有 Boss 守关。
被裹成雪球的敌人如果长时间不管，会挣脱并变得更快，所以裹住之后要尽快推走。
p_en: Each stage spawns a set of monsters. Cover an enemy in snow until it becomes a giant snowball, then push it to knock out everything in its path. Clear all enemies to advance; a boss guards every few stages.
A snowed-up enemy left alone will break free and move faster, so push the snowball away quickly.

p: 方向键负责移动，跳跃与喷雪分别对应手柄的 A / B 两键（本站 P1 默认按键为 U、I）。进入游戏后可以先试按几下确认手感。
所有按键都可以在工具栏「改键」里自定义，同时支持手柄即插即玩和触屏按钮。
p_en: Move with the D-pad; jumping and snow spray map to the gamepad A / B buttons (P1 defaults here are U and I). Press them a few times after the game starts to get a feel.
Every key can be remapped under Remap Keys in the toolbar, and gamepads plus touch buttons work too.

p: 把敌人完全裹住再推，雪球越大、撞到的敌人越多；推动的大雪球能连锁撞倒一串敌人，一次清屏的分数更高。
敌人掉落的食物可以加分，有助于冲击高分与隐藏奖励；注意不要站在雪球的滚动路线上，否则会被自己的雪球撞倒。双人游玩时一人引怪、一人推球，配合起来过关更快。
p_en: Wrap enemies fully before pushing: bigger snowballs hit more enemies, and one rolling snowball can chain-knock a whole line for a bigger score.

Grab the food dropped by enemies for points and bonus chances. Never stand in a snowball's rolling path, or it will knock you down. In 2-player mode, have one player lure monsters while the other pushes snowballs to clear stages faster.

p: LJ65 是 NES 平台的俄罗斯方块类型 ROM，也是 jsnes 官方示例自带的演示游戏，规则与经典俄罗斯方块完全一致。
各种形状的方块从顶部不断下落，把它们堆放整齐、消除得分，考验反应与规划能力。
p_en: LJ65 is a Tetris-style ROM for the NES and the demo game bundled with the official jsnes example. Its rules match classic Tetris exactly.
Blocks of various shapes keep falling from the top. Stack them neatly, clear lines for points, and test your reflexes and planning.

p: 左右移动并旋转下落的方块，把它们严丝合缝地堆在底部；当某一整行被填满时即可消除得分。
方块堆到顶部即告结束，目标是尽可能拿到更高分数、坚持更长时间。
p_en: Move and rotate falling pieces to pack them tightly at the bottom. Fill an entire row to clear it for points.
The game ends when the stack reaches the top, so aim for the highest score and the longest survival.

p: 方向键左右移动方块，A / B 键旋转或加速下落（具体以游戏内为准，本站 P1 默认按键为 U、I），Enter 开始或暂停。
全部按键都可以在工具栏「改键」中自定义，也支持手柄与触屏操作。
p_en: Move pieces left and right with the D-pad; the A / B buttons rotate or soft-drop (check in-game; P1 defaults here are U and I), and Enter starts or pauses.
All keys can be customized under Remap Keys, with gamepad and touch support included.

p: 尽量保持栈面平整，避免出现填不上的深洞；预留一竖列专门等长条，一次消除四行得分最高。
方块尽量往低处放，不要过早把两边堆高；提前看“下一个方块”预览，规划好落点再下手，高手都是走一步看两步。
p_en: Keep the stack surface flat and avoid deep holes you cannot fill. Reserve one vertical column for the long bar to score a four-line Tetris.
Place pieces low instead of stacking the sides early. Watch the next-piece preview and plan each landing ahead—masters always think two moves forward.

p: Croom 是社区流传的 NES homebrew 演示 ROM，体积很小，主要用于模拟器测试与尝鲜，目前还没有整理出完整的玩法资料。
如果你只是想体验模拟器，可以先从它入手；想认真玩一局，更推荐雪人兄弟或俄罗斯方块。
p_en: Croom is a small homebrew demo ROM circulating in the community, mainly used for emulator testing. No complete gameplay documentation exists for it yet.
It is fine for a quick emulator trial, but for a real game, try Snow Bros. or LJ65 Tetris instead.

p: 在模拟器中载入后按 Start（本站默认 Enter）进入；用方向键移动、A / B 键（默认 U / I）试探交互。
如果画面长时间没有反应，可以点工具栏「复位」重来，或者换一款游戏游玩。
p_en: After loading, press Start (Enter by default here) to enter. Probe the controls with the D-pad and the A / B buttons (U / I by default).
If nothing responds for a while, hit Reset in the toolbar or switch to another game.

p: 通用键位请参考模拟器页下方的键盘说明，所有按键都可以在「改键」中自定义；触屏设备可以直接使用屏幕按钮操作。
标准手柄插上即可使用，无需额外设置。
p_en: See the keyboard reference below the emulator for default keys; everything can be remapped under Remap Keys, and touch devices can use the on-screen buttons.
Standard gamepads work as soon as you plug them in, with no setup needed.

p: 如果你摸清了 Croom 的玩法，欢迎通过「联系」页告诉我们，我们核实后会把攻略补全，帮助更多玩家。
原创的玩法心得同样欢迎投稿，优质内容会署名收录。
p_en: If you figure out how Croom plays, tell us via the Contact page and we will complete this guide after verifying, helping more players.
Original gameplay write-ups are welcome too, and quality submissions will be credited.
